question: Should OpenClaw retire the manually enabled Workspaces beta now, before the replacement session-dashboard feature lands, with Doctor removing only verified retired plugin state?
rationale: This is an intentional product-surface removal with a user-data cleanup path; tests can validate mechanics, but they cannot decide whether the beta compatibility tradeoff is acceptable before its replacement is available.

options.title: Retire after migration proof
options.body: Keep the removal direction, require redacted Doctor evidence for retired-state deletion and configured-workspace preservation, then merge.

options.title: Keep the beta temporarily
options.body: Retain the disabled Workspaces plugin until the replacement dashboard is available, avoiding an interim loss for manually enabled beta users.

recommendation.title: Retire after migration proof
recommendation.body: Keep the removal direction, require redacted Doctor evidence for retired-state deletion and configured-workspace preservation, then merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current removal and Doctor-repair design were authored in the linked commit sequence.
